questions.question: Describe the personal hygiene practices that street food handlers must follow to prevent food contamination. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the personal hygiene practices that street food handlers must follow to
  • prevent food contamination.
  • • Wash hands thoroughly before handling food and after restroom use.
  • • Wear clean clothes, apron, and head cover.
  • • Keep nails short and clean; avoid jewelry.
  • • Do not smoke, eat, or sneeze near food.
  • • Cover cuts or wounds and report illness to supervisor.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the role of proper sealing techniques in maintaining the safety and quality of packaged food products. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the role of proper sealing techniques in maintaining the safety and quality
  • of packaged food products.
  • • Prevents entry of contaminants, moisture, and air.
  • • Maintains internal pressure or vacuum to ensure product integrity.
  • • Extends shelf life and prevents spoilage.
  • • Provides tamper evidence and consumer safety.
  • • Maintains legal compliance and product traceability.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the role of regular inspection and preventive maintainance schedules in ensuring hygienic premises in the food industry / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the role of regular inspection and preventive maintenance schedules in
  • ensuring hygienic premises in the food industry.
  • • Identifies equipment wear, damage, or leaks before breakdown.
  • • Prevents contamination due to malfunctioning machinery.
  • • Ensures compliance with hygiene and safety standards.
  • • Reduces downtime and improves productivity.
  • • Maintains records for verification and audits.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write a short note on sanitation practices under GMP / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Write a short note on sanitation practices under GMP.
  • • Scheduled cleaning and disinfection of all areas.
  • • Use of approved detergents and sanitizers.
  • • Regular cleaning of equipment, utensils, and surfaces.
  • • Maintenance of cleaning logs and checklists.
  • • Verification of sanitation effectiveness through swab tests.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the importance of monitoring water quality and sanitation in food processing environment / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the importance of monitoring water quality and sanitation in food
  • processing environment.

  • • Prevents microbial and chemical contamination.
  • • Maintains hygiene in washing, processing, and cleaning.
  • • Regular testing and documentation support food safety.
  • • Poor water quality affects taste, colour, and shelf life of food.

questions.question: Explain in detail about,how can visitor becme a source of contamination in food premises.give examples / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain in detail about how can visitor become a source of contamination in food
  • premises. Give examples.
  • • Visitors may introduce pathogens via clothing, footwear, or equipment.
  • • Contamination from respiratory droplets or poor hygiene.
  • • Unauthorized entry into processing areas can cause cross-contamination.
  • • Lack of awareness about GMP or hygiene rules.
  • • Preventive measures: restrict access, provide protective clothing, maintain visitor
  • logs, ensure handwashing, and escort visitors.
  • • Example: Contamination of dairy product by visitor carrying pathogens.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the importance of designing food premises to allow easy cleaning and maintenance. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the importance of designing food premises to allow easy cleaning and
  • maintenance.
  • • Proper layout ensures smooth workflow and prevents cross-contamination.
  • • Smooth, washable walls and floors facilitate cleaning.
  • • Adequate lighting and ventilation prevent microbial growth.
  • • Slope in flooring for proper drainage.
  • • Avoids accumulation of dirt and pests.
  • • Reduces cleaning time, improves safety, and meets GMP standards.
  • • Easier inspection and maintenance enhance operational efficiency.
  • • Design supports segregation of raw and cooked zones.
  • • Example: Stainless steel equipment and tiled surfaces.
  • • Ensures compliance with FSSAI Schedule 4.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the significance of using smooth, washable surfaces in food equipment and containers. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the significance of using smooth, washable surfaces in food equipment and
  • containers.
  • • Prevents accumulation of dirt and microorganisms.
  • • Facilitates easy cleaning and sanitization.
  • • Increases equipment durability and prevents corrosion.
  • • Non-reactive materials prevent chemical contamination.
  • • Smooth surfaces reduce risk of biofilm formation.
  • • Helps maintain product quality and safety.
  • • Example: stainless steel, food-grade plastic.
  • • Meets FSSAI, BIS, and GMP hygiene requirements.
  • • Reduces cleaning time and resource use.
  • • Essential for compliance during food audits.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the role of management in implimenting Good Manufacturing Practices(GMP) and food safety / [CO3] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the role of management in implementing Good Manufacturing Practices
  • (GMP) and food safety.
  • • Develops and enforces food safety policy and objectives.
  • • Provides training and awareness for employees.
  • • Allocates resources for sanitation and maintenance.
  • • Ensures documentation and internal audits.
  • • Monitors compliance with FSSAI and ISO 22000.
  • • Implements corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • • Reviews performance through regular audits.
  • • Promotes food safety culture within organization.
  • • Liaises with regulatory authorities.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
